youtube.title: Why Ice Cream Gives You Brain Freeze 🧠 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Brain freeze isn't your brain freezing.

Cold hits the roof of your mouth, and the blood vessels there suddenly tighten. Then they rush open again to warm up, and a big nerve sends out an alarm. Your brain gets confused and feels the pain in your forehead. The quick fix? Press your tongue to the roof of your mouth to warm it up. And the twist: your brain itself can't feel pain at all.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
